heading: How can I make website images smaller?
introduction: Compress supported JPG, PNG and WebP still images while keeping their original display dimensions by default. Choose a quality mode, a separate maximum-size target or an explicit format conversion.

sections.heading: Prepare a mixed image batch
sections.body: Add your images, keep their formats or choose a supported output, and review the default Maximum mode. JPEG and WebP use a stronger quality trade-off; PNG may reduce colors while preserving transparency. Choose Balanced, High quality or PNG Lossless when you need more detail. Review every result at the same scale as its original.

sections.heading: Match the format to the image
sections.body: JPG is useful for photographs. PNG and WebP can retain transparent backgrounds. JPG output is unavailable for transparent images so that a background is not silently flattened.

sections.heading: Check dimensions as well as file size
sections.body: No preset silently resizes an image. Enable Resize this image only when you want different dimensions; the original aspect ratio is retained and smaller images are not enlarged. Check text, edges and transparency before keeping the download.
